## [What is a digital marketing manager remote?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-is-a-Digital-Marketing-Manager-Remote-job)

A Digital Marketing Manager Remote job involves overseeing online marketing strategies and campaigns while working from a remote location. This role includes tasks such as SEO, social media management, email marketing, paid ads, and content strategy to drive brand awareness and lead generation. Digital Marketing Managers collaborate with teams, analyze performance metrics, and adjust strategies to achieve business objectives. Strong communication, analytical, and project management skills are essential for success in this role.

## [What are some common daily responsibilities for a digital marketing manager working remotely?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-are-some-common-daily-responsibilities-for-a-Digital-Marketing-Manager-working-remotely)

A Digital Marketing Manager working remotely typically manages online campaigns, analyzes performance metrics, coordinates content and social media calendars, and communicates with both internal teams and external partners. They often start their day by reviewing current campaign analytics and making data-driven adjustments to strategies. Collaboration is done via digital project management tools and regular video meetings to ensure seamless execution of marketing initiatives. Additionally, remote managers are expected to stay updated on industry trends and adapt tactics to maximize engagement and ROI. This role requires both strategic planning and hands-on execution to drive brand growth from a distance.

## [What are the key skills and qualifications needed to thrive in the digital marketing manager remote position, and why are they important?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-are-the-key-skills-and-qualifications-needed-to-thrive-in-the-Digital-Marketing-Manager-Remote-position-and-why-are-they-important)

To excel as a Digital Marketing Manager Remote, a solid background in digital marketing strategies, analytics, and campaign management—usually demonstrated by a relevant degree and experience—is essential. Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, SEO/SEM platforms, social media advertising suites, and certifications such as Google Ads or HubSpot are highly valuable. Excellent communication, self-motivation, and organizational skills help facilitate collaboration and project management in a remote environment. These attributes are crucial for driving successful marketing initiatives, achieving measurable results, and effectively working within distributed teams.

## [How much does a digital marketing manager get paid?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-Manager-Remote-How-much-does-a-digital-marketing-manager-get-paid)

A Digital Marketing Manager typically earns an annual salary between $70,000 and $120,000 in the United States, depending on experience, company size, and industry. Factors such as proficiency in SEO, paid advertising platforms like Google Ads and Meta Ads, and analytics tools like Google Analytics or HubSpot can influence compensation, with remote roles often aligning with national averages rather than local cost-of-living adjustments.

## Job description

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such as email, notes, tasks and calendar, and they’re not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world who is not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, and enable high-quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

To own to own social media strategy and execution, community management, and paid digital marketing

You will build our digital presence, grow and engage audiences, and drive user acquisition through organic and paid channels.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own social media strategy, content publishing and growth across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms

- Create and manage social content strategy, UGC campaigns and creator partnerships

- Build and engage communities across Reddit, Hacker News, Discord and relevant AI and technology forums

- Own paid advertising across Meta, Google, TikTok, X and other digital platforms, including budgets, targeting and optimisation

- Execute digital campaigns for product launches, audience growth and user acquisition

- Track and optimise engagement, conversion, acquisition costs and campaign ROI


What You'll Need

- 5+ years of experience in digital, social media, performance or growth marketing, preferably in consumer technology sector

- Proven track record growing social audiences and driving measurable engagement

- Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns across major platforms

- Strong understanding of social algorithms, online communities and content distribution

- Experience with UGC, influencer marketing and creator partnerships

- Strong analytical skills, creativity and ability to execute independently


Nice to Have

- Experience marketing consumer mobile applications or AI products

- Experience growing social channels or communities from zero

- Experience running digital campaigns across international markets

web.markdown:
[![Wpromote logo](https://lever-client-logos.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/7c34bf79-88f6-4f75-ae0b-0b6e2de79384-1777319009493.png)](https://jobs.lever.co/wpromote)

## Senior Paid Search Manager

Remote, United States

Paid Media – Paid Search /

Full Time /

Remote

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/wpromote/859d0ced-47af-4fd8-8458-34c78742f2e0/apply)

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Search Manager to join the rapidly expanding team that is the backbone of our company. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will be focused on 1-3 clients that will challenge you! As an individual contributor, you’ll be trusted to oversee all account activity, collaborate with managers from other channels, and come up with campaign strategies for your client.

### You Will Be

- Planning, developing, and implementing comprehensive paid search strategies to drive direct response and new user acquisition for your client.
- Utilizing business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow the relationship and client investments.
- Mentoring a pod of Coordinators, Associate Managers, and/or Managers
- Creating and managing paid search accounts/campaigns via various paid search marketing platforms including but not limited to: Google Ads®, Microsoft Ads®, Criteo®, etc.
- Managing Search, Shopping, Display, Remarketing, App Install and Video advertising campaigns.
- Working with direct response advertising strategies to drive sales revenue and/or qualified leads.
- Conducting keyword research, writing ad copy, and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs.
- Creating and implementing campaign A/B test experiments to identify optimal campaign settings
- Using Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to improve paid search performance and meet client goals.
- Analyzing paid search campaign results and adjust strategy and budgets accordingly.
- Communicating with clients regularly to discuss goals and deliver results through weekly, monthly, and quarterly calls.
- Developing strategies across all marketing channels to improve client goals (eg. CPA, ROAS) and achieve maximum efficiency
- Incorporating LLM based practices to accomplish account needs

### You Must Have

- 3+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid search industry
- Agency experience preferred with managing clients with monthly budgets ranging between $50,000-$500,000 per client
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Excellent analytical skills
- Deep knowledge of the SEM industry and the paid search advertising model
- Experience with keyword research tools and web analytics tools (Google Analytics), as well as how to use these tools in paid search campaigns
- General knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO), social advertising, and web usability
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPS and chart building
- Extremely well organized, able to balance client timelines and business needs, possibly across multiple clients
- Work comfortably in dynamic, time-intensive environments where consistent fire drills and competing priorities are commonplace
- An understanding of customer lifetime value and optimizing towards profits based on client margins
- Ability to manage expectations and priorities
- Experience presenting to senior-level client contacts
- Strong working knowledge with Google Suite

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options\*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $85,000 - $104,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits and an annual performance bonus.

\*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

\*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

\*\*\*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

_Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams_

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via [wpromote.com](http://wpromote.com/) email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on [Wpromote.com/careers](http://wpromote.com/careers), it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability\*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

#LI-JL

#LI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

<li>Planning, developing, and implementing comprehensive paid search strategies to drive direct response and new user acquisition for your client.</li>
<li>Utilizing business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow the relationship and client investments.</li>
<li>Mentoring a pod of Coordinators, Associate Managers, and/or Managers</li>
<li>Creating and managing paid search accounts/campaigns via various paid search marketing platforms including but not limited to: Google Ads®, Microsoft Ads®, Criteo®, etc.</li>
<li>Managing Search, Shopping, Display, Remarketing, App Install and Video advertising campaigns.</li>
<li>Working with direct response advertising strategies to drive sales revenue and/or qualified leads.</li>
<li>Conducting keyword research, writing ad copy, and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs.</li>
<li>Creating and implementing campaign A/B test experiments to identify optimal campaign settings</li>
<li>Using Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to improve paid search performance and meet client goals.</li>
<li>Analyzing paid search campaign results and adjust strategy and budgets accordingly.</li>
<li>Communicating with clients regularly to discuss goals and deliver results through weekly, monthly, and quarterly calls.</li>
<li>Developing strategies across all marketing channels to improve client goals (eg. CPA, ROAS) and achieve maximum efficiency</li>
<li>Incorporating LLM based practices to accomplish account needs</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>You Must Have</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>3+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid search industry</li>
<li>Agency experience preferred with managing clients with monthly budgets ranging between $50,000-$500,000 per client</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li>
<li>Excellent analytical skills</li>
<li>Deep knowledge of the SEM industry and the paid search advertising model</li>
<li>Experience with keyword research tools and web analytics tools (Google Analytics), as well as how to use these tools in paid search campaigns</li>
<li>General knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO), social advertising, and web usability</li>
<li>Strong Microsoft Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPS and chart building</li>
<li>Extremely well organized, able to balance client timelines and business needs, possibly across multiple clients</li>
<li>Work comfortably in dynamic, time-intensive environments where consistent fire drills and competing priorities are commonplace</li>
<li>An understanding of customer lifetime value and optimizing towards profits based on client margins</li>
<li>Ability to manage expectations and priorities</li>
<li>Experience presenting to senior-level client contacts</li>
<li>Strong working knowledge with Google Suite</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered" data-qa="closing-description"><div>
<div>At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.</div>
<div> </div>
<div>We offer:</div>
<div> </div>
<div>-Remote-first culture</div>
<div>-Unlimited PTO</div>
<div>-Extended Holiday break (Winter)</div>
<div>-Flexible schedules</div>
<div>-Work from anywhere options*</div>
<div>-100% paid parental leave</div>
<div>-401(k) matching</div>
<div>-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance</div>
<div>-Sponsored life insurance</div>
<div>-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance</div>
<div>-Annual Class Pass credits and more!</div>
<div> </div>
<div>The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $85,000 - $104,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits and an annual performance bonus.</div>
<div> </div>
<div>
<div>*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions</div>

## [What is digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-is-digital-marketing)
It involves strategies like content marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), pay-per-click advertising, and social media marketing to reach and engage target audiences online.

## [What job does a digital marketing do?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-job-does-a-digital-marketing-do)
A digital marketing professional develops and implements online marketing strategies to promote products or services. They use tools like social media, email campaigns, SEO, and analytics to reach target audiences and measure campaign effectiveness. Strong communication skills and knowledge of digital platforms are essential for success in this role.

## [What jobs are available in digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-jobs-are-available-in-digital-marketing)
These positions often require skills in analytics tools, content creation, and campaign management, with certifications like Google Ads or HubSpot being advantageous.

## [What is digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-is-digital-marketing)

Digital marketing refers to the use of digital channels, such as websites, social media, email, search engines, and mobile apps, to promote products or services. It involves strategies like content marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), pay-per-click advertising, and social media marketing to reach and engage target audiences online. Digital marketing allows businesses to measure results in real-time, target specific demographics, and optimize campaigns for better performance. It is essential for organizations looking to grow their presence and compete in today’s digital-first marketplace.

## [What are the qualifications to get a job in digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-Are-the-Qualifications-to-Get-a-Job-in-Digital-Marketing)

The qualifications and skills that you need to start a career in digital marketing depend on the duties and responsibilities of your position. Employers at digital marketing agencies may seek a degree in marketing or advertising. Writers, graphic designers, and web design professionals should earn a degree in their area of specialization. You can also pursue a postsecondary certificate from a community college. There are professional certifications as well, such as the Digital Marketing Certification from the American Marketing Association. You should maintain a portfolio of work to show employers.

## [What are the key skills and qualifications needed to thrive as a digital marketing professional, and why are they important?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-are-the-key-skills-and-qualifications-needed-to-thrive-as-a-Digital-Marketing-professional-and-why-are-they-important)

To thrive as a Digital Marketing professional, you need expertise in content creation, SEO/SEM strategies, analytics, and a solid understanding of marketing fundamentals, often supported by a degree in marketing or relevant certifications. Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, social media platforms, email marketing software, and advertising platforms such as Google Ads or Facebook Ads Manager is essential. Creativity, adaptability, and strong communication skills help you effectively engage audiences and collaborate across teams. These abilities are crucial for driving online brand growth, measuring campaign performance, and adapting to the fast-changing digital landscape.

## [What are some common challenges digital marketing professionals face when adapting to new platforms or technologies?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-are-some-common-challenges-digital-marketing-professionals-face-when-adapting-to-new-platforms-or-technologies)

Digital marketing professionals often encounter challenges when integrating new platforms or technologies, such as staying updated with rapidly evolving algorithms, learning new tools efficiently, and ensuring consistent brand messaging across diverse channels. Adapting quickly while maintaining campaign effectiveness requires ongoing learning and flexibility. Collaborating closely with other team members, such as content creators and data analysts, helps ensure smooth adoption and maximizes the potential of new digital solutions.

## [What is the difference between Digital Marketing vs Content Marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-is-the-difference-between-Digital-Marketing-vs-Content-Marketing)

| Aspect | Digital Marketing | [Content Marketing](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/Jobs/Content-Marketing) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Focus | Broad online promotion strategies including SEO, PPC, email, social media | Creating and distributing valuable content to attract and engage audiences |
| Skills | SEO, SEM, analytics, social media management | Content creation, storytelling, copywriting |
| Work Environment | Digital agencies, marketing departments, freelance | Content teams, marketing agencies, in-house marketing |
| Certifications | Google Ads, HubSpot, Facebook Blueprint | Content marketing certifications, HubSpot, Content Marketing Institute |

Digital Marketing encompasses a wide range of online promotional tactics, while Content Marketing specifically focuses on creating valuable content to attract and retain audiences. Both roles often overlap but serve different strategic purposes within digital campaigns.

## [Can I become a digital marketing in 3 months?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-Can-I-become-a-digital-marketing-in-3-months)

Becoming a digital marketing professional in three months is possible with intensive learning, focusing on key skills like SEO, social media, and analytics, along with practical experience or certifications. However, mastery and advanced roles typically require ongoing experience beyond this timeframe.

## [Can I start a digital marketing career with no experience?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-Can-I-start-a-digital-marketing-career-with-no-experience)

Digital marketing is accessible to beginners, and many entry-level roles do not require prior experience. Developing skills in areas like social media, content creation, and analytics, along with certifications such as Google Analytics or HubSpot, can help start a career in this field.

## [What job does a digital marketing do?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-job-does-a-digital-marketing-do)

A digital marketing professional develops and implements online marketing strategies to promote products or services. They use tools like social media, email campaigns, SEO, and analytics to reach target audiences and measure campaign effectiveness. Strong communication skills and knowledge of digital platforms are essential for success in this role.

## [What jobs are available in digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Digital-Marketing-What-jobs-are-available-in-digital-marketing)

Jobs in digital marketing include roles such as digital marketing manager, social media specialist, content marketer, SEO analyst, email marketing coordinator, and pay-per-click (PPC) specialist. These positions often require skills in analytics tools, content creation, and campaign management, with certifications like Google Ads or HubSpot being advantageous.

## Job description

**About the Role**

AMD Lasers is seeking a Marketing Specialist who combines strong writing skills with hands-on experience managing digital advertising and analyzing marketing performance.

Working closely with our marketing leadership, graphic designer, social media specialist, and sales team, this person will turn campaign priorities into clear messaging, coordinated execution, and actionable reporting. This is a dedicated position responsible for written marketing content, Google and Meta advertising, and marketing analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Writing & Content**

- Writes and edits copy for marketing materials, including promotional emails, brochures, sales sheets, website content, video scripts, webinar invitations, social captions, and paid advertisements.
- Translates technical product information into clear, accurate messaging tailored to the audience.
- Develops messaging for promotions, product launches, customer education, and sales-support campaigns.
- Coordinates with design, social media, product, and regulatory teams to keep content consistent and move materials through review.
- Maintains the marketing content calendar and tracks campaign deliverables and deadlines.

**Digital Advertising**

- Manages day-to-day Google Ads and Meta advertising under marketing leadership's oversight.
- Develops and updates campaign copy, audience targeting, and advertising assets in coordination with the team.
- Monitors spending, campaign performance, and conversion results.
- Tests and refines campaigns and recommends changes to improve results within approved budgets.
- Coordinates advertising schedules with promotions, webinars, product priorities, and other marketing activities.

**Analytics & Reporting**

- Tracks campaign performance using Shopify, advertising platforms, email marketing tools, and other available data sources.
- Analyzes sales, conversions, email engagement, advertising efficiency, and customer purchasing trends.
- Prepares recurring reports and review presentations that explain results, identify opportunities, and recommend next steps.
- Checks data accuracy and clearly distinguishes sales channels, reporting periods, and attribution limitations.
- Supports campaign tracking, customer segmentation, and lead tagging.

**Campaign Coordination**

- Coordinates campaign execution across email, paid advertising, website content, and supporting materials.
- Maintains project status and deadlines in the team's project management system.
- Works with sales to align campaign messaging and materials with customer needs.
- Documents workflows, campaign settings, and reporting processes to maintain continuity.

_This position supports social media through copywriting and paid Meta advertising. Organic social media planning, publishing, and community management are handled by a separate team member._

**Qualifications**

- At least two years of relevant experience in digital marketing, marketing communications, or a similar role.
- Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with samples demonstrating clear promotional and informational content.
- Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta advertising, including performance monitoring and budget tracking.
- Experience creating and coordinating email marketing campaigns.
- Ability to analyze marketing data and turn findings into clear reports and practical recommendations.
- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets and presentation tools.
- Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage overlapping deadlines.
- Ability to take ownership, follow through independently, and communicate when requirements or priorities need clarification.

**Preferred Experience**

- B2B, dental, healthcare, or technical-product marketing.
- Shopify, Mailchimp, Zoho, ClickUp, or comparable platforms.
- Customer segmentation, e-commerce reporting, and conversion tracking.
- Writing for product launches, webinars, and customer education.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your résumé and two or three relevant writing samples. If available, include a sample marketing report or a brief example of a paid advertising campaign you managed, explaining your responsibilities and results. **Remove confidential information from all samples.**

Content\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eWrites and edits copy for marketing materials, including promotional emails, brochures, sales sheets, website content, video scripts, webinar invitations, social captions, and paid advertisements.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTranslates technical product information into clear, accurate messaging tailored to the audience.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eDevelops messaging for promotions, product launches, customer education, and sales-support campaigns.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eCoordinates with design, social media, product, and regulatory teams to keep content consistent and move materials through review.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eMaintains the marketing content calendar and tracks campaign deliverables and deadlines.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDigital Advertising\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eManages day-to-day Google Ads and Meta advertising under marketing leadership\u0026#39;s oversight.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eDevelops and updates campaign copy, audience targeting, and advertising assets in coordination with the team.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eMonitors spending, campaign performance, and conversion results.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTests and refines campaigns and recommends changes to improve results within approved budgets.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eCoordinates advertising schedules with promotions, webinars, product priorities, and other marketing activities.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAnalytics \u0026amp; web.description:
## Paid Search Manager (B2B)
Remote, United States

Remote

You'll help manage search initiatives across multiple campaigns, products, and audiences while partnering with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, and other channel teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

### You Will Be
- Serving as a trusted strategic partner to enterprise B2B clients by leading paid search strategy, performance optimization, and ongoing business planning across complex performance marketing programs
- Managing sophisticated paid search account structures across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360, and other relevant paid search platforms
web.markdown:
[![Wpromote logo](https://lever-client-logos.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/7c34bf79-88f6-4f75-ae0b-0b6e2de79384-1777319009493.png)](https://jobs.lever.co/wpromote)

## Paid Search Manager (B2B)

Remote, United States

B2B – Strategy /

Full Time /

Remote

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/wpromote/af0f35a1-d0e7-42bb-a90d-38042d803f7d/apply)

**The Role**

We're seeking a Paid Search Manager to support strategy and execution across enterprise and mid-market accounts within Wpromote's growing B2B practice. This individual contributor (IC) role will partner with senior team members to drive performance through thoughtful campaign management, optimization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The ideal candidate has experience managing paid search campaigns within an agency environment and enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll help manage search initiatives across multiple campaigns, products, and audiences while partnering with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, and other channel teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

### You Will Be

- Serving as a trusted strategic partner to enterprise B2B clients by leading paid search strategy, performance optimization, and ongoing business planning across complex performance marketing programs
- Owning both strategy and execution by developing campaign architecture, optimization plans, testing roadmaps, and operational improvements that drive measurable business results
- Managing sophisticated paid search account structures across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360, and other relevant paid search platforms
- Driving strategic planning, forecasting, budget management, testing initiatives, and performance optimization aligned with client business goals
- Translating campaign performance and business insights into clear, actionable recommendations for client stakeholders
- Partnering closely with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, SEO, and other channel teams to develop integrated marketing strategies
- Identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies, audience expansion, and performance innovation across client programs
- Maintaining strong campaign health through proactive monitoring, QA processes, and optimization best practices
- Participating in client meetings, performance reviews, and presentations while building strong client relationships
- Staying current on search platform updates, AI-driven search innovations, automation capabilities, and industry best practices

### You Must Have

- 1.5-3 years of experience managing paid search campaigns within an agency environment
- Experience supporting B2B paid search programs across enterprise or mid-market clients preferred
- Experience managing campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads; familiarity with Search Ads 360 (SA360) is a plus
- Working knowledge of campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding strategies, automation, and conversion optimization
- Strong analytical skills with experience using GA4 and reporting platforms to evaluate performance and identify optimization opportunities
- Experience interpreting campaign data and communicating recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience participating in client-facing conversations
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across several client accounts
- Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment
- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP

### Nice to Have

- Experience supporting SaaS, fintech, adtech, and other B2B technology organizations preferred
- Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot, or other CRM integrations for lead generation measurement
- Experience managing offline conversion tracking and lead quality optimization
- Familiarity with first-party audience strategies, CRM integrations, and advanced attribution methodologies
- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and automation to improve campaign efficiency and performance

### What We Offer

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options\*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $74,000 - $90,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget.  The total compensation package for this role will include benefits .

\*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

\*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

\*\*\*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

_Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams_

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via [wpromote.com](http://wpromote.com/) email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on [Wpromote.com/careers](http://wpromote.com/careers), it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

#LI-CK

#LI-Remote

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability\*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/wpromote/af0f35a1-d0e7-42bb-a90d-38042d803f7d/apply)

<div> </div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>You Will Be</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Serving as a trusted strategic partner to enterprise B2B clients by leading paid search strategy, performance optimization, and ongoing business planning across complex performance marketing programs</li>
<li>Owning both strategy and execution by developing campaign architecture, optimization plans, testing roadmaps, and operational improvements that drive measurable business results</li>
<li>Managing sophisticated paid search account structures across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360, and other relevant paid search platforms</li>
<li>Driving strategic planning, forecasting, budget management, testing initiatives, and performance optimization aligned with client business goals</li>
<li>Translating campaign performance and business insights into clear, actionable recommendations for client stakeholders</li>
<li>Partnering closely with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, SEO, and other channel teams to develop integrated marketing strategies</li>
<li>Identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies, audience expansion, and performance innovation across client programs</li>
<li>Maintaining strong campaign health through proactive monitoring, QA processes, and optimization best practices</li>
<li>Participating in client meetings, performance reviews, and presentations while building strong client relationships</li>
<li>Staying current on search platform updates, AI-driven search innovations, automation capabilities, and industry best practices</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>You Must Have</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>1.5-3 years of experience managing paid search campaigns within an agency environment</li>
<li>Experience supporting B2B paid search programs across enterprise or mid-market clients preferred</li>
<li>Experience managing campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads; familiarity with Search Ads 360 (SA360) is a plus</li>
<li>Working knowledge of campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding strategies, automation, and conversion optimization</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills with experience using GA4 and reporting platforms to evaluate performance and identify optimization opportunities</li>
<li>Experience interpreting campaign data and communicating recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients</li>
<li>Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience participating in client-facing conversations</li>
<li>Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across several client accounts</li>
<li>Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment</li>
<li>Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Nice to Have</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Experience supporting SaaS, fintech, adtech, and other B2B technology organizations preferred</li>
<li>Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot, or other CRM integrations for lead generation measurement</li>
<li>Experience managing offline conversion tracking and lead quality optimization</li>
<li>Familiarity with first-party audience strategies, CRM integrations, and advanced attribution methodologies</li>
<li>Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and automation to improve campaign efficiency and performance</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What We Offer</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><div>
<div>At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.</div>
<div> </div>
<div>We offer:</div>
<div>-Remote-first culture</div>
<div>-Unlimited PTO</div>
<div>-Extended Holiday break (Winter)</div>
<div>-Flexible schedules</div>
<div>-Work from anywhere options*</div>
<div>-100% paid parental leave</div>
<div>-401(k) matching</div>
<div>-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance</div>
<div>-Sponsored life insurance</div>
<div>-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance</div>
<div>-Annual Class Pass credits and more!</div>
<div> </div>
<div>The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $74,000 - $90,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget.  The total compensation package for this role will include benefits .</div>
<div> </div>
<div>
<div>*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions</div>
<div>**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!</div>

## Location
United States (Remote)

## Department
S&MMarketing

## About You
You'll thrive as a Demand Generation Manager if you:

## What You'll Do
- Design, launch, and own always-on demand gen campaigns (paid, email nurture, content syndication) that keep pace with a rapidly growing sales team's pipeline needs
- Partner directly with sales leadership and reps to align campaigns to territory and segment expansion, so new hires ramp with pipeline in hand
- Run experiments across channels (paid social, paid search, webinars, retargeting, ABM) and double down on what generates pipeline, not just clicks

## Who You Are
- 4+ years running demand generation or growth marketing campaigns end-to-end in B2B SaaS
- Comfortable partnering closely with a fast-growing sales and SDR team, adjusting to what they actually need, and developing integrated campaigns that heavily involve collaboration with sales
- Strong command of marketing automation and attribution tooling (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, or similar)
- Data-driven — you can tie a campaign to a number sales actually cares about
- Experience working on field events, driving attendance, follow-ups, and promotion

## Our Commitment to You
Compensation Range: $128K - $173K

- [![LiveKit](https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/org-theme-wordmark/c7f786d9-6b65-4a57-a228-ac3b704e7ade/766937d1-97de-4de0-8b56-f1091d5ac04e/cf5c3d52-f071-4722-be52-9dfd5ce3af19.png)](https://livekit.io/)

# Demand Generation Manager

## Location

United States (Remote)

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

S&MMarketing

## Compensation

- $128K – $173K • Offers Equity

## About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

## About You

You'll be building the demand gen function from a real foundation, not patching around one, with a sales org that actually wants what you're building.

You'll thrive as a Demand Generation Manager if you:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tools and skills


The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

## What You'll Do

- Design, launch, and own always-on demand gen campaigns (paid, email nurture, content syndication) that keep pace with a rapidly growing sales team's pipeline needs

- Build and manage the campaign calendar and reporting cadence, giving sales and marketing leadership a clear view of MQL/SQL flow

- Partner directly with sales leadership and reps to align campaigns to territory and segment expansion, so new hires ramp with pipeline in hand

- Manage lead scoring, routing, and attribution so we can show — not just claim — what's working

- Run experiments across channels (paid social, paid search, webinars, retargeting, ABM) and double down on what generates pipeline, not just clicks


## Who You Are

- 4+ years running demand generation or growth marketing campaigns end-to-end in B2B SaaS

- Hands-on experience with paid, email, and content-driven campaigns. You've built and run these yourself, not just briefed an agency

- Comfortable partnering closely with a fast-growing sales and SDR team, adjusting to what they actually need, and developing integrated campaigns that heavily involve collaboration with sales

- Strong command of marketing automation and attribution tooling (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, or similar)

- Data-driven — you can tie a campaign to a number sales actually cares about

- Ability to troubleshoot and problem-solve on the fly

- Experience working on field events, driving attendance, follow-ups, and promotion


## Nice to Have

- Experience marketing to developers or technical buyers

- Experience scaling a demand gen function alongside a rapidly growing sales team

- ABM experience

- Some familiarity with voice AI, real-time infrastructure, or WebRTC — or the willingness to nerd out and learn fast


## Our Commitment to You

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy


LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

Compensation Range: $128K - $173K

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/livekit/0ce55391-93e3-4927-9cf2-3244756a7e2e/application)

## Digital Marketing Manager
Lehi, UT, US

Pattern Corporate – Advertising /

Full-time (Salary) /

Hybrid

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/pattern/7c7ecd7f-c704-46d2-97b3-e4f5b06e5d44/apply)

We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike. We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

### What will I need to thrive in this role?
- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)

### What does high performance look like?
- You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given

### What is the team like?
- You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.
web.markdown:
[![Pattern logo](https://lever-client-logos.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/bfdb02cb-6964-4c3c-993a-0fa4fc27f358-1772750152653.png)](https://jobs.lever.co/pattern)

## Digital Marketing Manager

Lehi, UT, US

Pattern Corporate – Advertising /

Full-time (Salary) /

Hybrid

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/pattern/7c7ecd7f-c704-46d2-97b3-e4f5b06e5d44/apply)

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, [Walmart.com](http://walmart.com/), [Target.com](http://target.com/), eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit [pattern.com](http://pattern.com/) or email [press@pattern.com](mailto:press@pattern.com).

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike.  We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

### What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

- Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
- Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
- Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
- Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
- Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

### What will I need to thrive in this role?

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
- Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
- Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
- Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

### Preferred Qualifications:

- Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
- Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
- Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
- Experience in retail revenue strategy

### What does high performance look like?

- You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
- You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
- You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
- You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
- You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
- You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

### What is my potential for career growth?

- You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

### What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

- 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
- 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
- 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

### What is the team like?

- You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

### We want individuals who are:

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

### What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

### How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
- Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics

**Why should I work at Pattern?**

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

\- Unlimited PTO

\- Paid Holidays

\- Onsite Fitness Center

\- Company Paid Life Insurance

\- Casual Dress Code

\- Competitive Pay

\- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

\- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.

Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

[Apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/pattern/7c7ecd7f-c704-46d2-97b3-e4f5b06e5d44/apply)

Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, </span><a href="http://walmart.com/"><span style="font-size: 16px;">Walmart.com</span></a><span style="font-size: 16px;">, </span><a href="http://target.com/"><span style="font-size: 16px;">Target.com</span></a><span style="font-size: 16px;">, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit </span><a href="http://pattern.com/"><span style="font-size: 16px;">pattern.com</span></a><span style="font-size: 16px;"> or email </span><a href="mailto:press@pattern.com"><span style="font-size: 16px;">press@pattern.com</span></a><span style="font-size: 16px;">.</span></div>
<div> </div>
<div><span style="font-size: 16px;">Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span style="font-size: 16px;">We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike.  We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.</span></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc. </li>
<li>Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients</li>
<li>Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas</li>
<li>Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity</li>
<li>Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What will I need to thrive in this role?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program</li>
<li>2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.) </li>
<li>Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills </li>
<li>Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners</li>
<li>Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude </li>
</ul>
<div> </div></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Preferred Qualifications:</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc. </li>
<li>Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3</li>
<li>Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models</li>
<li>Experience in retail revenue strategy</li>
</ul>
<div> </div></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What does high performance look like?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals</li>
<li>You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards</li>
<li>You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends</li>
<li>You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner</li>
<li>You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given</li>
<li>You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion</li>
</ul>
<div> </div></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What is my potential for career growth?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners</li>
<li>60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners</li>
<li>90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What is the team like?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>We want individuals who are:</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.</li>
<li>Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.</li>
<li>Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.</li>
<li>Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What is the hiring process?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team</li>
<li>Video interview with a hiring manager</li>
<li>Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders</li>
<li>Professional reference checks</li>
<li>Executive review</li>
<li>Offer</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>How can I stand out as an applicant?</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list" data-qa="posting-requirements"><div><ul>
<li>Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples</li>
<li>Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team</li>
<li>Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern</li>
<li>Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics</li>
</ul>
<div> </div></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered" data-qa="closing-description"><div><strong>Why should I work at Pattern?</strong></div>
<div> </div>
<div>Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:</div>
<div> </div>
<div>- Unlimited PTO</div>
<div>- Paid Holidays</div>
<div>- Onsite Fitness Center</div>
<div>- Company Paid Life Insurance</div>
<div>- Casual Dress Code</div>
<div>- Competitive Pay</div>
<div>- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance</div>
<div>- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. </div>
<div> </div>

## [What is a remote digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-is-a-Remote-Digital-Marketing-job)

A Remote Digital Marketing job involves promoting brands, products, or services online while working from a remote location. It includes tasks like SEO, content marketing, social media management, email marketing, and paid advertising. Digital marketers use tools like Google Analytics, social media platforms, and automation software to analyze data and optimize campaigns. This role allows professionals to work from anywhere with an internet connection, offering flexibility and global opportunities. Strong communication and analytical skills are essential for success in this field.

## [What are some common challenges faced in remote digital marketing roles and how can they be addressed?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-are-some-common-challenges-faced-in-remote-digital-marketing-roles-and-how-can-they-be-addressed)

Working as a remote digital marketing professional often means managing projects across different time zones and collaborating with team members virtually, which can sometimes lead to communication gaps or delays in feedback. Staying motivated and organized without in-person supervision and maintaining a healthy work-life balance are also common challenges. To address these, it's important to set clear priorities, leverage project management and communication tools, and establish regular check-ins with your team. Successful remote digital marketers are proactive in seeking clarification, openly sharing progress, and continuously updating their skills to adapt to evolving digital trends.

## [What are the key skills and qualifications needed to thrive in remote digital marketing, and why are they important?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/What-are-the-key-skills-and-qualifications-needed-to-thrive-in-the-Remote-Digital-Marketing-position-and-why-are-they-important)

To thrive as a Remote Digital Marketing professional, you need expertise in online campaign management, SEO/SEM, content creation, and analytics, often supported by a degree in marketing or related fields. Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, social media platforms, email marketing software, and certifications like Google Ads or HubSpot is highly valued. Strong communication, self-motivation, time management, and problem-solving skills help set you apart when working remotely. These skills ensure you can drive measurable results, manage multiple projects independently, and effectively collaborate with distributed teams.

## [Can you work in remote digital marketing?](https://www.ziprecruiter.com/e/Remote-Digital-Marketing-Can-you-work-in-remote-digital-marketing)

Remote digital marketing is a common career option that allows professionals to work from anywhere with an internet connection. It typically involves skills in SEO, content creation, social media management, and analytics, often using tools like Google Analytics and marketing automation platforms. Many companies hire remote digital marketers, offering flexible schedules and the ability to work independently.
