<p><b>Job Summary</b></p>
<p>We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to elevate our brand presence across digital channels. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that drive engagement, increase conversions, and boost overall online visibility. Your expertise in a wide range of digital tools and platforms will be essential to crafting compelling content, managing paid advertising campaigns, and analyzing performance metrics to inform strategic decisions. Join us to shape innovative marketing initiatives that captivate audiences and generate measurable growth!</p>
<p><b>Duties</b></p>
<ul>
 <li>Plan, execute, and manage integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, and social media channels.</li>
 <li>Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings and improve website visibility.</li>
 <li>Create engaging content for websites, blogs, email marketing, and social media to attract and retain target audiences.</li>
 <li>Manage website content using content management systems like WordPress and optimize site performance through technical SEO practices.</li>
 <li>Design visually appealing graphics and banners using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite for digital ads and social media posts.</li>
 <li>Monitor campaign performance using web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms; generate detailed reports to track KPIs.</li>
 <li>Oversee paid advertising campaigns including SEM (Search Engine Marketing) and paid search marketing strategies to maximize ROI.</li>
 <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams on website management, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization initiatives.</li>
 <li>Implement tracking pixels, set up conversion tracking, and analyze data to refine targeting strategies for better campaign outcomes.</li>
 <li>Stay updated on the latest trends in digital marketing, social media advertising campaigns, and emerging tools to continuously improve our strategies.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Requirements</b></p>
<ul>
 <li>Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEO tools, SEM, paid advertising campaign management, and analytics platforms.</li>
 <li>Proficiency in website management systems such as WordPress; familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL is highly desirable.</li>
 <li>Skilled in using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Creative Suite for graphic design tasks related to digital campaigns.</li>
 <li>Hands-on experience with Google Ads (formerly Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation tools.</li>
 <li>Strong copywriting skills coupled with the ability to craft compelling content tailored for diverse audiences across multiple channels.</li>
 <li>Knowledge of web analytics reporting techniques to measure campaign success and inform future strategies.</li>
 <li>Technical proficiency in website optimization techniques including keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and A/B testing methodologies.</li>
 <li>Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.</li>
 <li>Excellent communication skills with a proactive approach to collaboration across teams such as sales, creative services, and IT.</li>
</ul>
<p>Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will drive impactful campaigns! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values creativity, analytical thinking, and continuous learning—all while offering paid positions that recognize your expertise!</p>
<p>Pay: $25.00 per hour</p>
<p>Expected hours: 40.0 per week</p>
<p>Experience:</p>
<ul>
 <li>SEO: 3 years (Required)</li>
 <li>Digital marketing: 3 years (Required)</li>
</ul>

# Digital Marketing Manager - Americas

Tampa, Florida, United States Remote

Apply

**About Appspace:**

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

**Your Role as a Digital Marketing Manager:**

We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale Appspace’s paid media engine. Paid media is the primary mandate of this role—you will control significant advertising budgets across search, social, and display channels, and be held accountable for pipeline contribution and ROAS. Beyond paid, you’ll help optimize our website for conversion and AI-engine discoverability, and partner cross-functionally to ensure every dollar of digital spend is tied directly to revenue outcomes.

_This is not a generalist role. The right candidate lives in campaign dashboards, obsesses over cost-per-opportunity, and knows how to scale what’s working while ruthlessly cutting what isn’t._

**A Day in the Life of a Digital Marketing Manager:**

1. Own and Optimize Paid Media Programs

Paid media performance is the core metric by which this role is measured. You will:

- Manage and allocate multi-channel paid media budgets across Google Ads (Search, Display, P-Max), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, 6sense, and Meta Ads—continuously rebalancing based on pipeline contribution and cost-per-opportunity.
- Build and maintain always-on advertising programs alongside point-in-time campaign bursts, ensuring consistent pipeline coverage throughout the fiscal year.
- Develop quarterly paid media plans grounded in buyer persona research, intent data, and competitive analysis; translate strategy into channel-specific execution plans with clear KPIs.
- Define and own paid media KPIs: CTR, CPC, CPL, cost-per-MQL, cost-per-opportunity, ROAS, and pipeline-influenced revenue. Report weekly to senior leadership.
- Run structured A/B tests on ad copy, creative, audience segments, bidding strategies, and landing pages; document results and scale winners systematically.
- Design and test ad creative and copy by leveraging AI generation tools alongside content and design teams—using performance data to drive the next iteration of brand assets.
- Leverage B2B intent data and account-intelligence platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora) to build targeted ABM ad campaigns aligned with Sales outbound targets.
- Stay current with platform algorithm changes (Google’s AI-driven bidding, LinkedIn audience expansion, Meta Advantage+) and adapt strategies proactively.

1. Optimize Website Performance

- Measure and monitor the Appspace website’s health, performance, and conversion rates; share regular dashboards with marketing leadership and stakeholders.
- Optimize web content, layout, structure, and UX for both human conversions (CRO) and AI-engine discoverability (SEO/AEO), ensuring Appspace surfaces across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery.
- Manage and coordinate with Appspace’s external SEO agency—set deliverables, hold the agency accountable to results, and integrate SEO insights into paid media and content strategies.
- Implement and maintain website tracking through Google Tag Manager.

1. Collaborate Across the Marketing & Revenue Team

- Feed paid media performance data, search intent trends, and AI-discovery insights back into the content engine—partnering with creative, copywriting, and content teams so messaging continually evolves based on real-time market signals.
- Work hand-in-hand with Revenue Operations to manage multi-touch attribution models, ensuring all digital spend is mapped to pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue.
- Support integrated campaigns by handling all paid advertising components: planning, audience building, ad construction, trafficking, and measurement.
- Contribute to quarterly and annual marketing planning by providing paid media performance data and forward-looking budget recommendations.

**What You'll Need:**

- **Paid Media Expertise (Required):** 5+ years managing substantial B2B SaaS paid media budgets with demonstrable results—specific experience driving pipeline from Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta is essential. Please be prepared to share performance results.
- **AI-Augmented Execution:** Hands-on use of AI-driven marketing workflows—ad copy generation, audience modeling, bid optimization, and creative testing at scale.
- **Platform Mastery:** Expert-level command of Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM and SFDC reporting.
- **ABM & Intent Data:** Practical experience using B2B intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent) to build targeted account-based campaigns in close partnership with Sales.
- **Analytical Rigor:** Ability to move beyond surface-level reporting—interpret multi-touch attribution, journey-aware bidding signals, and predictive analytics to make budget decisions with confidence.
- **Web & CRO Fluency:** Solid understanding of CMS management, landing page builders (e.g., Unbounce, Webflow), and conversion rate optimization best practices.
- **Revenue Mindset:** Comfortable tying digital spend directly to pipeline and closed-won revenue; you speak the language of Sales and RevOps, not just marketing.
- **Adaptability:** A bias for action and experimentation in a fast-changing landscape where AI platforms and buyer behaviors shift quickly.

**The Perks of Working for Appspace:**

For all our US based team members, we offer a variety of benefits from competitive salaries, medical, dental and vision coverage, disability coverage, employer paid life insurance, mental health resources, 401(k) plan and a fully paid parental leave program.

Additional perks include:

- Generous PTO
- Flexible work schedules
- Remote work opportunities
- Paid company holidays
- Appspace Quiet Fridays (No non-essential internal meetings scheduled)
- A casual dress work environment

**Disclaimer:**

_Appspace is committed to equitable compensation practices and complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. For jurisdictions that require pay scale disclosure, a general compensation range may be provided during the initial stages of the interview process. Final compensation will be based on multiple factors including experience, skills, certifications, and overall fit for the role._

_If you are located in a jurisdiction with specific pay transparency requirements, we will be happy to discuss the relevant range during your application process._

Digital Marketing Manager - Americas

Tampa, Florida, United States Remote

About Appspace:

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

 

Your Role as a Digital Marketing Manager:

We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale Appspace’s paid media engine. Paid media is the primary mandate of this role—you will control significant advertising budgets across search, social, and display channels, and be held accountable for pipeline contribution and ROAS. Beyond paid, you’ll help optimize our website for conversion and AI-engine discoverability, and partner cross-functionally to ensure every dollar of digital spend is tied directly to revenue outcomes.

This is not a generalist role. The right candidate lives in campaign dashboards, obsesses over cost-per-opportunity, and knows how to scale what’s working while ruthlessly cutting what isn’t.

A Day in the Life of a Digital Marketing Manager:

  1. Own and Optimize Paid Media Programs 

Paid media performance is the core metric by which this role is measured. You will:

  • Manage and allocate multi-channel paid media budgets across Google Ads (Search, Display, P-Max), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, 6sense, and Meta Ads—continuously rebalancing based on pipeline contribution and cost-per-opportunity.
  • Build and maintain always-on advertising programs alongside point-in-time campaign bursts, ensuring consistent pipeline coverage throughout the fiscal year.
  • Develop quarterly paid media plans grounded in buyer persona research, intent data, and competitive analysis; translate strategy into channel-specific execution plans with clear KPIs.
  • Define and own paid media KPIs: CTR, CPC, CPL, cost-per-MQL, cost-per-opportunity, ROAS, and pipeline-influenced revenue. Report weekly to senior leadership.
  • Run structured A/B tests on ad copy, creative, audience segments, bidding strategies, and landing pages; document results and scale winners systematically.
  • Design and test ad creative and copy by leveraging AI generation tools alongside content and design teams—using performance data to drive the next iteration of brand assets.
  • Leverage B2B intent data and account-intelligence platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora) to build targeted ABM ad campaigns aligned with Sales outbound targets.
  • Stay current with platform algorithm changes (Google’s AI-driven bidding, LinkedIn audience expansion, Meta Advantage+) and adapt strategies proactively.
  1. Optimize Website Performance
  • Measure and monitor the Appspace website’s health, performance, and conversion rates; share regular dashboards with marketing leadership and stakeholders.
  • Optimize web content, layout, structure, and UX for both human conversions (CRO) and AI-engine discoverability (SEO/AEO), ensuring Appspace surfaces across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery.
  • Manage and coordinate with Appspace’s external SEO agency—set deliverables, hold the agency accountable to results, and integrate SEO insights into paid media and content strategies.
  • Implement and maintain website tracking through Google Tag Manager.
  1. Collaborate Across the Marketing & Revenue Team
  • Feed paid media performance data, search intent trends, and AI-discovery insights back into the content engine—partnering with creative, copywriting, and content teams so messaging continually evolves based on real-time market signals.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Revenue Operations to manage multi-touch attribution models, ensuring all digital spend is mapped to pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue.
  • Support integrated campaigns by handling all paid advertising components: planning, audience building, ad construction, trafficking, and measurement.
  • Contribute to quarterly and annual marketing planning by providing paid media performance data and forward-looking budget recommendations.

What You'll Need:

  • Paid Media Expertise (Required): 5+ years managing substantial B2B SaaS paid media budgets with demonstrable results—specific experience driving pipeline from Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta is essential. Please be prepared to share performance results.
  • AI-Augmented Execution: Hands-on use of AI-driven marketing workflows—ad copy generation, audience modeling, bid optimization, and creative testing at scale.
  • Platform Mastery: Expert-level command of Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM and SFDC reporting.
  • ABM & Intent Data: Practical experience using B2B intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or equivalent) to build targeted account-based campaigns in close partnership with Sales.
  • Analytical Rigor: Ability to move beyond surface-level reporting—interpret multi-touch attribution, journey-aware bidding signals, and predictive analytics to make budget decisions with confidence.
  • Web & CRO Fluency: Solid understanding of CMS management, landing page builders (e.g., Unbounce, Webflow), and conversion rate optimization best practices.
  • Revenue Mindset: Comfortable tying digital spend directly to pipeline and closed-won revenue; you speak the language of Sales and RevOps, not just marketing.
  • Adaptability: A bias for action and experimentation in a fast-changing landscape where AI platforms and buyer behaviors shift quickly.

The Perks of Working for Appspace:

For all our US based team members, we offer a variety of benefits from competitive salaries, medical, dental and vision coverage, disability coverage, employer paid life insurance, mental health resources, 401(k) plan and a fully paid parental leave program.

Additional perks include:

  • Generous PTO
  • Flexible work schedules
  • Remote work opportunities
  • Paid company holidays
  • Appspace Quiet Fridays (No non-essential internal meetings scheduled)
  • A casual dress work environment 

Disclaimer:

Appspace is committed to equitable compensation practices and complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. For jurisdictions that require pay scale disclosure, a general compensation range may be provided during the initial stages of the interview process. Final compensation will be based on multiple factors including experience, skills, certifications, and overall fit for the role.

If you are located in a jurisdiction with specific pay transparency requirements, we will be happy to discuss the relevant range during your application process.

# Senior Demand Generation Manager

Remote - United States

Apply

## **The Opportunity:**

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger.

It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline.

You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working.

## **What You'll Do**

- Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself.
- Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution.
- Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results.
- Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume.
- Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync.
- Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution.
- Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread.

## **What You'll Bring**

- A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync.
- Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency.
- Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks.
- B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle.
- Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners.
- Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role.

The Opportunity:

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger.

It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline.

# Performance Marketing Manager
## Location

## Department
Marketing

As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. - [Back to 1Password’s Job Listings](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password)

# Performance Marketing Manager

## Location

Remote (United States \| Canada)

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Marketing

_**1Password is growing.** We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing._

**About 1Password**

_At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work._

_If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future._

As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. Your work will help more people discover and adopt 1Password as we build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. Reporting to the Director, Performance & Paid Media, this role is remote in the United States and Canada.

**How we’re using AI today**

On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

**What we're looking for:**

• 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or user acquisition, ideally supporting PLG or Self-Serve business models.

• Hands-on experience managing paid marketing channels such as paid social, affiliates, display, programmatic, app-focused, influencer, or other emerging channels.

• Ability to use advertising platform data and marketing analytics to evaluate performance, make decisions, and improve campaigns when attribution data is incomplete.

• Experience connecting marketing activity to outcomes such as signups, trial starts, activation, paid conversion, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, or revenue.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Growth, Product Marketing, Analytics, creative partners, and other stakeholders.

• Experience supporting B2C or prosumer audiences, SaaS products, or self-serve customer journeys, along with familiarity with lifetime value (LTV) and CAC analysis.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools or automated workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, analysis, or decision-making.

**What you can expect:**

• Contribute to the PLG and Self-Serve performance marketing strategy across B2B and B2C audiences.

• Manage assigned paid channels and programs from awareness through conversion, including planning, execution, optimization, and reporting.

• Launch and optimize campaigns, evaluate channel performance, and identify opportunities across audiences, messaging, creative, and funnel stages.

• Build productive vendor relationships, manage account partnerships, and negotiate for stronger performance and value.

• Monitor leading indicators such as clicks, signups, trial starts, activation, and cost per acquisition, as well as outcomes including paid conversions, subscription volume, revenue, and retention.

• Design, run, and document experiments across channels, audiences, creative, offers, pricing pages, and other parts of the customer journey.

• Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve execution speed, reporting efficiency, and the quality of performance insights.

• Collaborate with campaign managers, Product Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and other partners to share learnings and make informed recommendations.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $97,000 USD and $136,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $93,000 CAD and $130,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

_This posting is for an existing vacancy._

**Our culture**

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, [_1Password is not for everyone_](https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/). Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

**How we work with AI**

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

**Our approach to remote work**

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

**What we offer**

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

_Health and wellbeing_

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

_Growth and future_

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

_Community_

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

_\*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting._

**You belong here.**

_1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love._

_Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs._

_Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you._

_Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law._

_1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See_ [_here_](https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf) _for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing_ [_this form_](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice) _. For additional information see our_ [_Candidate Privacy Notice_](https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf) _._

  <meta name="twitter:description" content="1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. Your work will help more people discover and adopt 1Password as we build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. Reporting to the Director, Performance & Paid Media, this role is remote in the United States and Canada.

How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or user acquisition, ideally supporting PLG or Self-Serve business models.

• Hands-on experience managing paid marketing channels such as paid social, affiliates, display, programmatic, app-focused, influencer, or other emerging channels.

• Ability to use advertising platform data and marketing analytics to evaluate performance, make decisions, and improve campaigns when attribution data is incomplete.

• Experience connecting marketing activity to outcomes such as signups, trial starts, activation, paid conversion, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, or revenue.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Growth, Product Marketing, Analytics, creative partners, and other stakeholders.

• Experience supporting B2C or prosumer audiences, SaaS products, or self-serve customer journeys, along with familiarity with lifetime value (LTV) and CAC analysis.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools or automated workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, analysis, or decision-making.

What you can expect:

• Contribute to the PLG and Self-Serve performance marketing strategy across B2B and B2C audiences.

• Manage assigned paid channels and programs from awareness through conversion, including planning, execution, optimization, and reporting.

• Launch and optimize campaigns, evaluate channel performance, and identify opportunities across audiences, messaging, creative, and funnel stages.

• Build productive vendor relationships, manage account partnerships, and negotiate for stronger performance and value.

• Monitor leading indicators such as clicks, signups, trial starts, activation, and cost per acquisition, as well as outcomes including paid conversions, subscription volume, revenue, and retention.

• Design, run, and document experiments across channels, audiences, creative, offers, pricing pages, and other parts of the customer journey.

• Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve execution speed, reporting efficiency, and the quality of performance insights.

• Collaborate with campaign managers, Product Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and other partners to share learnings and make informed recommendations.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $97,000 USD and $136,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $93,000 CAD and $130,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

ashby-job-posting-description"><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em><strong>1Password is growing.</strong> We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>About 1Password</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. Your work will help more people discover and adopt 1Password as we build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. Reporting to the Director, Performance & Paid Media, this role is remote in the United States and Canada.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>How we’re using AI today</strong><br>On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or user acquisition, ideally supporting PLG or Self-Serve business models.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Hands-on experience managing paid marketing channels such as paid social, affiliates, display, programmatic, app-focused, influencer, or other emerging channels.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Ability to use advertising platform data and marketing analytics to evaluate performance, make decisions, and improve campaigns when attribution data is incomplete.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Experience connecting marketing activity to outcomes such as signups, trial starts, activation, paid conversion, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, or revenue.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Growth, Product Marketing, Analytics, creative partners, and other stakeholders.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Experience supporting B2C or prosumer audiences, SaaS products, or self-serve customer journeys, along with familiarity with lifetime value (LTV) and CAC analysis.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Experience using AI-enabled tools or automated workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, analysis, or decision-making.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>What you can expect:</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Contribute to the PLG and Self-Serve performance marketing strategy across B2B and B2C audiences.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Manage assigned paid channels and programs from awareness through conversion, including planning, execution, optimization, and reporting.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Launch and optimize campaigns, evaluate channel performance, and identify opportunities across audiences, messaging, creative, and funnel stages.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Build productive vendor relationships, manage account partnerships, and negotiate for stronger performance and value.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Monitor leading indicators such as clicks, signups, trial starts, activation, and cost per acquisition, as well as outcomes including paid conversions, subscription volume, revenue, and retention.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Design, run, and document experiments across channels, audiences, creative, offers, pricing pages, and other parts of the customer journey.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve execution speed, reporting efficiency, and the quality of performance insights.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">• Collaborate with campaign managers, Product Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and other partners to share learnings and make informed recommendations.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $97,000 USD and $136,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $93,000 CAD and $130,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.<br><br>At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.<br><br><em>This posting is for an existing vacancy.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><br><strong>Our culture </strong><br>At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. <br><br>You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/"><em>1Password is not for everyone</em></a>. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. <br><br><strong>How we work with AI</strong><br>We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.<br><br><strong>Our approach to remote work </strong><br>We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.<br><br><strong>What we offer</strong><br>We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: <br><br><em>Health and wellbeing</em><br>👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs<br>🩺 Competitive health benefits<br>🏝 Generous PTO policy <br><br><em> Growth and future </em><br>📈 RSU program for most employees<br>💸 Retirement matching program<br>🔑 Free 1Password account<br><br><em>Community </em><br>🤝 Paid volunteer days <br>🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly<br>🌎 Remote-first work environment<br><em>*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>You belong here.</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.</em></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See </em><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf"><em><u>here</u></em></a><em> for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing </em><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice"><em><u>this form</u></em></a><em>. For additional information see our </em><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf"><em><u>Candidate Privacy metadata.title: Performance Marketing Manager @ 1Password
metadata.og:description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. Your work will help more people discover and adopt 1Password as we build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. Reporting to the Director, Performance & Paid Media, this role is remote in the United States and Canada.

How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or user acquisition, ideally supporting PLG or Self-Serve business models.

• Hands-on experience managing paid marketing channels such as paid social, affiliates, display, programmatic, app-focused, influencer, or other emerging channels.

• Ability to use advertising platform data and marketing analytics to evaluate performance, make decisions, and improve campaigns when attribution data is incomplete.

• Experience connecting marketing activity to outcomes such as signups, trial starts, activation, paid conversion, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, or revenue.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Growth, Product Marketing, Analytics, creative partners, and other stakeholders.

• Experience supporting B2C or prosumer audiences, SaaS products, or self-serve customer journeys, along with familiarity with lifetime value (LTV) and CAC analysis.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools or automated workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, analysis, or decision-making.

What you can expect:

• Contribute to the PLG and Self-Serve performance marketing strategy across B2B and B2C audiences.

• Manage assigned paid channels and programs from awareness through conversion, including planning, execution, optimization, and reporting.

• Launch and optimize campaigns, evaluate channel performance, and identify opportunities across audiences, messaging, creative, and funnel stages.

• Build productive vendor relationships, manage account partnerships, and negotiate for stronger performance and value.

• Monitor leading indicators such as clicks, signups, trial starts, activation, and cost per acquisition, as well as outcomes including paid conversions, subscription volume, revenue, and retention.

• Design, run, and document experiments across channels, audiences, creative, offers, pricing pages, and other parts of the customer journey.

• Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve execution speed, reporting efficiency, and the quality of performance insights.

• Collaborate with campaign managers, Product Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and other partners to share learnings and make informed recommendations.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $97,000 USD and $136,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $93,000 CAD and $130,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.

Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As part of 1Password’s Performance & Paid Media team, you’ll help grow our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Self-Serve business across Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) audiences. You’ll manage paid marketing programs across the funnel, turn performance data into clear decisions, and help build efficient ways of working—including through artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows. Your work will help more people discover and adopt 1Password as we build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. Reporting to the Director, Performance & Paid Media, this role is remote in the United States and Canada.

How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or user acquisition, ideally supporting PLG or Self-Serve business models.

• Hands-on experience managing paid marketing channels such as paid social, affiliates, display, programmatic, app-focused, influencer, or other emerging channels.

• Ability to use advertising platform data and marketing analytics to evaluate performance, make decisions, and improve campaigns when attribution data is incomplete.

• Experience connecting marketing activity to outcomes such as signups, trial starts, activation, paid conversion, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, or revenue.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Growth, Product Marketing, Analytics, creative partners, and other stakeholders.

• Experience supporting B2C or prosumer audiences, SaaS products, or self-serve customer journeys, along with familiarity with lifetime value (LTV) and CAC analysis.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools or automated workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, analysis, or decision-making.

What you can expect:

• Contribute to the PLG and Self-Serve performance marketing strategy across B2B and B2C audiences.

• Manage assigned paid channels and programs from awareness through conversion, including planning, execution, optimization, and reporting.

• Launch and optimize campaigns, evaluate channel performance, and identify opportunities across audiences, messaging, creative, and funnel stages.

• Build productive vendor relationships, manage account partnerships, and negotiate for stronger performance and value.

• Monitor leading indicators such as clicks, signups, trial starts, activation, and cost per acquisition, as well as outcomes including paid conversions, subscription volume, revenue, and retention.

• Design, run, and document experiments across channels, audiences, creative, offers, pricing pages, and other parts of the customer journey.

• Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve execution speed, reporting efficiency, and the quality of performance insights.

• Collaborate with campaign managers, Product Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and other partners to share learnings and make informed recommendations.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $93,000 CAD and $130,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

**About LumiMeds**

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

### Location: Remote

### **About the Role**

You will own paid acquisition across major ad platforms while improving conversion rates and lifecycle performance. You will work closely with the Creative Director, product, and leadership to scale acquisition efficiently while maintaining compliance with platform and healthcare regulations.

You are not responsible for graphic design — but you must drive testing strategy and performance optimization.

* * *

## **What You’ll Own**

**1\. Paid Acquisition (Core Responsibility)**

Own strategy, execution, and optimization across:

- Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube)
- Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
- Reddit Ads
- Tiktok Ads
- Microsoft Ads (Bing)
- App Lovin
- Ad Roll

Responsibilities:

- Manage and scale paid budgets efficiently
- Optimize CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, and LTV
- Conduct structured A/B testing across copy,creatives, offers, audiences, and funnels
- Adjust bidding strategies and campaign structure based on data
- Identify scaling opportunities without increasing risk exposure

You must understand advertising restrictions related to healthcare, medical claims, and regulated products.

**2\. Landing Page & Funnel Optimization (CRO)**

- Improve and test multiple funnels
- Recommend landing page structure improvements
- Suggest pricing tests, bundling experiments, and offer adjustments
- Propose creative test variations to the Creative Director
- Improve checkout and subscription flow performance

_Important: You do not design visuals, but you drive performance testing strategy._

**3\. Compliance & Platform Policy Awareness**

- ​​Ensure campaigns comply with platform ad policies (Google, Meta, etc.)
- Understand regulated marketing limitations (medical claims, disclaimers)
- Partner with internal stakeholders to prevent account flags or shutdown risk
- Maintain a risk-aware scaling strategy

### **4\. Lifecycle & Retention (Critical Gap to Build)**

Own and build our lifecycle marketing engine:

- SMS automation
- Email automation
- Abandoned cart flows
- Post-purchase sequences
- Subscription retention campaigns
- Win-back flows

Goals:

- Increase LTV
- Improve retention rates
- Reduce churn
- Personalize messaging based on behavior

Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms preferred.

### **5\. Analytics & Attribution**

- Build reporting dashboards
- Monitor CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, and LTV
- Understand subscription economics (LTV > CAC model)
- Improve attribution clarity across channels
- Inform budget allocation decisions using data

* * *

## **What Success Looks Like**

- Scalable paid acquisition without compliance risk
- Improved landing page conversion rates
- Strong subscription retention engine
- Predictable unit economics
- Clear reporting and budget confidence

* * *

## **What We’re Looking For**

- 5+ years in performance or growth marketing
- Strong hands-on experience with:

  - Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube)
  - Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
  - Reddit Ads
  - Tiktok Ads
  - Microsoft Ads (Bing)
  - App Lovin
  - Ad Roll

- Experience in telehealth, healthcare, or regulated products preferred
- Experience with subscription-based businesses strongly preferred
- Strong CRO mindset
- Experience building SMS + email lifecycle automations
- Comfortable operating in a startup environment with ownership

* * *

## **This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who**

- Thinks in CAC vs LTV
- Enjoys structured experimentation
- Understands platform compliance nuance
- Is analytical but commercially minded
- Can operate without heavy hand-holding

* * *

## **Why Join LumiMeds**

- Early-stage growth opportunity.
- Direct impact on company revenue.
- Real ownership of strategy and execution.
- High visibility with leadership.
- Opportunity to shape the marketing foundation of a Telehealth brand.

**How to Apply**

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

_Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours._
